description: The classic number-merging puzzle. Slide every tile on the board at once, and when two tiles with the same number touch, they combine into one. Keep merging to build bigger numbers and try to reach the 2048 tile before the board fills up.
howto: Use the arrow keys or WASD to slide the tiles. On a phone, swipe in any direction. Press the New Game button to start over.

title: Stacky Hero Master
description: Guide your runner through twisting maze levels, scooping up blocks as you go. Your stack of blocks is also your bridge, so plan a route that collects enough to cross every gap and reach the finish. Each level adds a new layout to figure out.
howto: Click or tap to use the buttons and steer your hero through the maze. Pick up as many blocks as you can before you need to build across a gap.

title: Halloween Fighters
description: A spooky arcade brawler with a roster of 11 monsters to pick from. Fight your way across 12 haunted stages, chain punches and kicks into combos, and take down three huge bosses. Turn the difficulty up once you've learned your monster's moves.
howto: Move with the arrow keys or WASD. Punch with Z or J and kick with X or K. Hold a direction while you attack to pull off different moves.

title: Geometry Vibes 3D
description: A rhythm platformer that takes the flat Geometry Vibes formula into 3D. Your shape races forward on its own to the beat, and you have to time every jump to clear spikes, gaps and moving blocks. One mistake sends you back, so each run is about learning the level.
howto: Jump with W, the Up arrow, Space or a left click. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen to jump.

title: Super Nitro Racing 3
description: A top-down racer with 21 tracks and changing weather. Your car speeds up by itself, so winning comes down to taking clean lines through the corners and saving your nitro for the straights.
howto: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD. Brake with Space or Down. Use nitro with N, Shift or Up.

title: Galaxy Pop
description: A bubble shooter set in outer space. Fire colored bubbles into the cluster above and match three or more of the same color to pop them. Bank shots off the walls to reach the tricky spots.
howto: Drag to aim, then let go to shoot. Works with a mouse or a finger.

title: Monster Truck Offroad 2
description: Drive a giant monster truck up steep mountain trails, over rocks and across rough ground. Each level has checkpoints you need to reach before the timer runs out, without flipping your truck.
howto: W or Up to speed up, S or Down to brake, A and D to steer, and Space for the handbrake.

title: Happy Orange Glass
description: A drawing puzzle where you sketch lines and ramps so the orange juice flows into the glass. Every level has a different layout, and there's usually more than one clever way to solve it.
howto: Draw with the mouse or your finger. When you let go, the juice starts pouring.

title: Merge Monsters
description: A card-stacking number puzzle with cute monsters. Move numbered cards between four stacks and put matching numbers together so they merge into bigger ones. Run out of room and the game is over.
howto: Hold and drag a card onto another stack. Matching numbers merge automatically.

title: Fish Sort Puzzle
description: A relaxing underwater sorting game. Fish float around in bubbles, and your job is to send each one to the tank that matches its color before the tanks fill up the wrong way.
howto: Click or tap a fish to send it to a tank.

title: Candy Sort
description: A color-sorting brain teaser. Move candies between tubes until every tube holds just one color. You can only place a candy on top of the same color or into an empty tube.
howto: Click a tube to pick up the top candy, then click another tube to drop it.

title: 9 Ball Pool 3D
description: A 3D game of 9-ball pool against computer players. Sink the balls in order and pocket the 9 to win the rack. Try the three-round championship or race the clock in timed mode.
howto: Move the mouse to aim. Click once to set your shot and again to strike.

title: Football Pinball
description: Pinball meets soccer. The table is a football pitch, and you flip the ball to defend your goal and blast it into your opponent's. Quick reflexes win matches.
howto: Use the Left and Right arrows or A and D for the flippers. Space flips both.

title: Animal Kart
description: A side-scrolling kart race with cartoon animals. Jump over obstacles and gaps to stay ahead across 60 tracks, and unlock new racers and upgrades as you win.
howto: Click, tap or press Space to jump. Jump again in the air to double-jump.

title: Ninja Platformer Rage
description: A tough platformer full of traps. Your ninja can throw a shadow and teleport to it, which is the key to getting past spikes and long drops. 50 levels that get harder fast.
howto: A/D or the arrow keys to move, Space to jump, and Shift to throw your shadow.

title: Gorbo the Orc: Crown Quest
description: Someone stole Gorbo's golden crown, and he wants it back. Run, jump and swing your axe through 48 levels across six worlds, beating monsters along the way.
howto: Run with the arrow keys or WASD, jump with Space, and swing with X or J.

title: Level Once Again
description: A puzzle platformer with a story. Guide Veer through 100 trap-filled rooms and 7 boss fights to rescue Tara. Rooms that look simple usually hide a trick.
howto: Move with the arrows or A/D, jump with Space, and press R to restart a room.

title: Grazing Giraffe
description: A cozy sliding puzzle about a very long, very hungry giraffe. Slide around the board so its neck covers every tile, without getting stuck against a wall.
howto: Swipe or use the arrow keys to slide. Press R to rewind a move.

title: Solitaire The Collection
description: 33 kinds of solitaire in one game, including Klondike and Spider. Play a daily challenge, earn achievements, and customize your cards and table.
howto: Click cards to move them and build sequences. The rules for each game type are shown in-game.

title: Mummy Candy
description: A physics puzzle set in ancient Egypt. Cut the ropes at the right moment so the candy swings, drops and bounces into the hungry mummy's mouth.
howto: Swipe with the mouse or your finger across a rope to cut it.

title: Skybound Dash: Crown Rush
description: Flap your way through glowing gates and grab crowns across 12 levels. It's all about timing and rhythm.
howto: Click, tap or press Space to flap.

title: Fat Duck Frenzy
description: An endless runner on a candy road. Switch lanes to dodge traffic, jump over barriers and gaps, and see how far your duck can get.
howto: Steer with Left/Right or A/D. Jump with Space or W. Press P to pause.

title: Hazard Pay
description: A sneaky platformer set in the world's worst factory, where the levels try to trick you. Pick workers with different abilities and survive 60 shifts.
howto: Move with the arrows or A/D and jump with Space.

title: Ice Cream Vendor
description: Run an ice cream counter during the rush. Pick the cone, stack the flavors and add toppings to match each customer's order before they get impatient.
howto: Click or tap the buttons to build each order.

title: Spellbound Orbs
description: A magical orb shooter set in a wizard's castle. Match three or more orbs of the same color to clear them, with boosters to help across a huge number of levels.
howto: Drag to aim and let go to shoot.

title: Alien Quarantine
description: A top-down sci-fi shooter. A research station has been overrun by alien creatures, and you have 20 missions to clear it out and make it back.
howto: Move with WASD or the arrows, aim with the mouse, click to fire, and press E to interact.

title: Flume
description: A 3D endless runner inside a twisting half-pipe that never stops. Keep your speed up, avoid the obstacles, and unlock new balls with higher scores.
howto: Steer with A/D or the arrows and boost with Space.

title: Infinity Sky
description: Bounce higher and higher up endless platforms while dodging monsters. A quick game to play when you've got a few minutes.
howto: Click the left or right side of the game, or press A/D. On a phone, tap the sides of the screen.
